messages:
ana (eng-runtime): FYI after landing the kernel-path rewrite we see a consistent tail-latency bump on host-side streaming for short payloads. p95 up ~3x. anyone catch this on their dashboards? :eyes:

omar (eng-runtime): saw it. looks like short-gen and chat-streamers primarily. p50 unchanged.

felix (perf): grabbed a quick flame; tokenize + parse_token dominates, and we have a surge of writev syscalls. link: https://pprof.internal/5987/host-tokenize-writev (internal)

felix (perf): top:
```
33.6% parse_token
17.2% writev/syscall
11.4% kernel_path::select_variant
9.1% kv_cache::lookup
```

sarah (infra): tcpdump shows many small grpc frames instead of coalesced writes. looks like MSG_MORE not used on one fast-path.

ana (typo) ana (eng-runtime): repro command I ran:
```
wrk -t12 -c250 -d45s --script=short_stream.lua http://canary:8080/v1/stream
```

omar (eng-runtime): root-cause hypothesis: kernel_path select now calls validate_variant() per-request which rebuilds tokenizer context because metadata hash mismatch (we started including non-deterministic fields). That forces allocate_tokenizer and extra memcpys.

felix (perf): also smaller batch sizes from the new batching heuristic amplify KV cache misses. Previously a single batch amortized kv lookups; now each request does its own lookup -> L1 churn.

sarah (infra): combined effect -> increased syscalls (writev) + more CPU in tokenize -> p95 spikes.

ana ana (eng-runtime): quick mitigation options:
- revert kernel-path change (fast)
- make metadata-hash stable (medium)
- preserve tokenizer pool across validation (medium)
- force MSG_MORE for streaming writes (fast)

omar (eng-runtime): i prefer revert + hotfix for pool reuse. revert buys time.

felix (perf): I validated MSG_MORE locally: setting MSG_MORE on intermediate grpc chunks reduced syscalls by ~60% and p95 roughly halved on repro host. gist: https://git.internal/gists/5987-msgmore

sarah (infra): deploy-bot, can we roll back kernel-path on canaries?

canary-bot: Rolling back feature flag kernel-path-rewrite on canary group (canary-1..3). Started at 14:07. Status: in-progress.

omar (eng-runtime): i'll open a small PR that changes validate_variant() to only hash a stable subset: model_id, architecture, quant_profile. Exclude ephemeral fields like build_timestamp and optional flags.

felix (perf): i'll run a 10m wrk + pprof on canary post-rollback to confirm. Goal: p95 within 20% of baseline.

canary-bot: Rollback completed on canary hosts. Health checks passing.

ana ana (eng-runtime): can confirm canary p95 back to ~48ms from 130ms. Holding full rollout until PR merged and perf-guard in CI.

omar (eng-runtime): follow-ups:
- merge stable-hash PR + unit test for hash invariants
- add tokenizer-pool reuse so validate path doesn't clear live pools
- land MSG_MORE guard in streaming layer
- add perf regression CI for short-stream scenario (wrk + pprof) gating kernel-path changes

felix (perf): will add perf job and a p95 fail threshold of +20% for short requests.

sarah (infra): documenting incident and blocking rollout in #release-war-room.

ana ana (eng-runtime): thanks all. tagging for postmortem later.
